narrative:
Credit impairment and provisions are EUR 8.6M in the FY2026 budget — about 4% of net operating income. In FY2025 the IFRS 9 ECL charge was EUR 3.6M (cost of risk about 21 bps on a EUR 1.72Bn loan book) and provisions for litigation, commitments and guarantees EUR 4.3M, down from EUR 10.7M in FY2024.

Asset quality is solid: NPL ratio 2.08% with 110.5% coverage, slightly above the EU averages of 1.90% and 100.5%. The watch items are two Andorran hospitality borrowers after a weak summer and the young Spanish loan book, which is still building lifetime provisions.

signals.title: NPL ratio 2.08%, coverage 110.5%
signals.excerpt: Credit investment €1,724M (+13.5%); EU averages 1.90% NPL and 100.5% coverage.
